main_text.p: EA,quæ in partes dividi non possunt{4}vt via, vt actio: aquæ ductus l.17.§.de feruitutib: l.11.§.14.§.de legatis.§.l.vltima §.de feruitut. legata., solida {b}l.2.§.2.§.de verborum obligat. à singulis heredibus debentur. ¹ ¶ In rei dubia benignior {c}v.l.155. in f.§.ce: l.74.§.de acqu. hereditate. interpretationem sequi, non minus iustius est, quàm tutius.
OMnia fere iura heredum perinde habentur, ac ii continuo{d}v.l.3. §.de heredit. petit: l.5.§.1. §.quod sub tempus mortis heredes ex-stitissent.

QUi per successionem quamuis longissimam{c}cum eo: l.7. in fine §. de acq. hereditl.65:l. 70. §.de verborum fignific: l. vlt.C.de heredibus institutis. defuncto heredes constituerunt, non minus heredes intelliguntur, quàm qui principaliter heredes existunt.
EXpressa nocent{f}, non expressa non nocent.

PRivilegia quædam causæ sunt, quædam personæ: & ideo quædam ad hæredem transmittuntur{e}nisi heredis vocabula adiecta sit restrictio, putà lego heredibus infrascriptis: nisi agatur de odio, nisi quædam specialis affectio defuncti aliud requirit v. Decium hic., quæ causæ{g} sunt, quæ personæ{h} sunt, ad heredem non transeunt.

page.notes: The running head and text were normalised for u/v and i/j per the spelling rule. Notes 4, b, c, d, e carry the margin reading as far as legible; several abbreviated citations (for example "l.77.§.ro" and "de condict.") are doubtful and marked [?] where uncertain. The Greek in footnotes g and i could not be read letter by letter and is marked illegible. Paragraph 197 ends after "quid": the line may continue but the scan does not show more text before the footnotes. The text mark after "nocent" in 195 is taken as f, matching the footnote. Margin notes 4 and b are attached by the marks visible in the text, with the mark for solida read as b.
